FN-QN3HN14-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 559
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Security
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/14/2025
House Bill 559 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of a local board of
education or the governing body of a public, two-year or four-year institution of higher
education to establish policies pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
